cat:record.dcterms:title: Language as Custody — Writing Without Harm in Post-Interpretive Criticism
cat:record.dcterms:creator: Dorian Vale
cat:record.dcterms:description: An essay considering how language may protect or distort the ethical force of artworks. It develops restraint in writing as a form of custodianship, particularly around trauma, silence, and exile.
